description: This file defines a DataTables plugin called RowsGroup, which enables multi-column row grouping and merging cells based on column values. It includes class-like structures, methods for managing grouping, and automatic initialization for DataTables instances.

classes.name: RowsGroup
classes.description: Class implementing multi-column row grouping and cell merging for DataTables.

methods.name: _getOrderWithGroupColumns
methods.description: Calculates the order array considering grouped columns and their directions.

methods.name: _getInjectedMonoSelectWorkaround
methods.description: Workaround for DataTables multi-ordering reset behavior when a single column is ordered.

methods.name: _mergeCells
methods.description: Merges table cells in grouped columns by hiding duplicates and setting rowspan.

methods.name: _mergeColumn
methods.description: Recursively merges cells in a specific column over a range of rows.

methods.name: _updateOrderAndDraw
methods.description: Updates the ordering considering grouping and redraws the table.
